correctness.rationale: The reduction \(\chi_{\varphi,P}\) is satisfiable exactly when a same-domain monotonicity counterexample exists. For the upper bound, the rank-\(r\) type-count profile from Carreiro et al. yields a canonical model; symbolic evaluation with one fresh representative per unary type handles ordinary and infinity quantifiers exactly and uses at most \((2^m+r)^r=2^{O(n^2)}\) branches. Lewis's monadic satisfiability lower bound transfers through \(\psi(P)=\theta\wedge\forall x\,\neg P(x)\). Empty domains cannot witness a strict enlargement of \(P\), so the reduction remains exact under the source paper's empty-domain convention.
